info.name: Microsoft 365 integration
info.summary: Two-way sync of Microsoft 365 calendars, contacts and To Do tasks
info.description:
Keeps Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online) calendars, contacts and Microsoft To Do lists in sync with Nextcloud Calendar, Contacts and Tasks — in both directions, through the Microsoft Graph API.
An administrator registers one application in Microsoft Entra ID (any tenant, or personal Microsoft accounts); each user connects their own Microsoft account and chooses which calendars, contact folders and task lists to synchronise. Changes made in Outlook appear in Nextcloud within minutes and vice versa. Read-only calendars (holidays, birthdays, subscriptions) can be imported.
**Requirements:** a working Nextcloud background job (cron) and an Entra ID app registration with the delegated Graph permissions Calendars.ReadWrite, Contacts.ReadWrite, Tasks.ReadWrite, User.Read and offline_access. The admin documentation walks through the registration.
**Data sent to Microsoft:** the calendar, contact and task data you choose to synchronise is read from and written to Microsoft Graph (graph.microsoft.com) on your behalf. Nothing else leaves your server.
info.author: Malte Zilinski
